tweet.text:
Just measured how much more AI usage you get from a subscription. $100 of Claude Max buys about $4,640 of Opus at API prices.

The results:
- Claude Max ($100): 46.4x on Opus 5.5, 27.3x on Fable 5.2
- Google AI Ultra ($99.99): 25.8x on Gemini 4 Neon
- X Premium ($30): 20.3x on Grok 4.7
- ChatGPT Pro ($100): 10.25x (measured in October)
- Muse Code High Usage ($15): 9.3x (October)

How this affects the Bug Hunt Benchmark: 🧵
